reviews.text: We took Comrade to another groomer (who shall not be named) for his first haircut and they shaved our boy bald. I’m sure it was as traumatic for Comrade as it was for us. We were fortunate enough to have found Kay for his second (and now forever) haircut, because she’s got it! Comrade loves to greet Kay with kisses and often takes a snooze during his haircut. This can be attributed to the warmth, energy and love that Kay puts into her work. More importantly, she never cuts Comrade’s cuteness off, which we appreciate. We are as loyal to Kay as my husband is to his barber of 30 years. In other words, we’re never leaving her! <3

I was looking for a spot to get my cat cleaned up and get his hair cut and Lurissa did a really good job. Very friendly atmosphere , Willy was very relaxed and calmed when I picked him up :) cool vibes
I have an American Bully and a Chihuahua. Kay is a dream with both of them. Love this salon !
They do a fantastic job with our dog, who sheds endlessly. She always smells so great and the de-shedding works wonders!

I was so nervous to take my rescue pomchi to a professional groomer, but since they are so close to home, I figured I would give it a try and I was not disappointed. They did so amazing! And it was quick. Would highly recommend!
Larissa at Kay’s did an amazing job on our 7 month old Bernedoodle! This was the first time at a groomer. Larissa did an excellent job and was very informative and caring! Thank you!

Great place been taking my Belle (yorkie)
Love them !!!!

Kay has always done a great job at grooming our Cavapoos. She is kind, affectionate toward the dogs, and the dogs seem to love being there. Kay works with the customer to have their pets looking exactly as they want. Her scheduling is easy and she happily prioritizes the people who have recurring appointments. Thank you for helping us!

I absolutely adore Kay's Pooches & Smooches. I've been bringing my Goldendoodle pup since he was 8 months old after a few frustrated grooming experience elsewhere. Kay's was referred to me by my breeder, which already made me comfortable. Kiara is our groomer and from day one she has been amazing about listening to our requests and guiding us as our pup's hair grows and changes. Opie feels safe and happy with their team. It is always a fun time for him.

I will always recommend Kay's Pooches & Smooches!
Best place for the perfect trim and manicure
Larissa is the greatest leaves my dog exactly how I envision him and the place is so cutely decorated

After five years of finding the right groomer, we are sooo happy to have found Kay’s pooches and smooches.  So grateful that they accomodated us right away with their first available. They were very professional and great customer service.  I’m most especially grateful that the one we scheduled for the day before did not work out simply because they had poor customer service and they suck.  And the groomer before that injured my dog’s ear by cutting it and giving it a hematoma!  I highly don’t recommend them - bubbles in a tub and buds and suds.  Horrible horrible horrible service!!!  But this  was an awesome experience for milo!  Thank you

I have a very elderly, very vocal, and very temperamental cat who needed some extra care & attention for her grooming. Kiara took absolutely amazing care of her and was just so gentle, going at a pace that allowed her to be as comfortable as possible. It is so appreciated!
Very friendly,  did an excellent job grooming my dog. Most importantly they handled her with care.
Very friendly staff and super fast. My Lucy was in and out and her nails looked great. Would recommend 👌
Those girls working here are god send. 6 stars if I could.
Excellent experience for our family’s cat, thank you!

We’ve been going to Kiara at Kay’s Smooches & Pooches since Axel’s second grooming at 6 months. He’s a year and four months now and Kiara’s made sure to always have him looking his absolute furry best! We couldn’t be happier with the service that Kiara provides to our fur baby each and every time. Axel is always excited for his appointment and is eager to run right in like the energy ball that he is! That immediately lets us know that he’s handled with such tender love and care with the staff there. Not to mention every time we’ve been there the shop is always looking spotless and clean which is what you want from any grooming business. The moment that you step in you’re instantly greeted with smiles and such a welcoming environment. The shampoo and conditioner that they use have our pup come back smelling so fresh and clean that lasts for days! They always leave his coat looking healthy and shiny after every grooming. We love the updates that Kiara gives us as that helps us make his grooming experience better for him and her as well. We couldn’t be anymore grateful to Kay’s smooches and pooches for the work they do day in and day out to make our pups the cutest and fluffiest fur babies anyone has ever seen! If I could give 10 stars I would!!!

I've been bringing my dog to Kay's for over a year now, and I can't recommend her enough! Kay is incredibly kind, welcoming, and genuinely caring. She always treats my dog with such sweetness and attention, which gives me total peace of mind every time I drop him off.
The grooming space is always clean and well-kept, and the location is super convenient for the neighborhood. It's clear that Kay loves what she does, and it shows in the way she connects with both pets and owners.
If you're looking for a trustworthy, professional, and warm-hearted groomer, Kay's is the place to go!

1st time bringing my husky here, they are very nice and I like that they handle one dog at a time. I used to take my dog to petsmart but it takes so long because they handle multiple dogs at a time and my husky gets so anxious when left in crate.

I’m satisfied and will come back for sure!

We adopted a beautiful yorkie/schnauzer mix August 2024 and yall she came to us very very raggedy lmao. I asked for recommendations on a Facebook group and someone recommended Kay’s and omg life has been so much easier since then. She’s so incredibly patient with our Nola and never judged her for the constant yapping! I have to show yall how Nola first looked when she came into our lives and just how great Kay’s works been!! 1: when she first got to us. 2: first appt with Kay. 3: bear faced groom 4: summer groom
Kay and her staff are so wonderful!! So gentle and kind and professional. My dog Delilah loves Kay and loves being cared for there!! Highly recommend!
Milo loves his summer haircut

Great service and Kay was exceptional.
Thank God I found this place for my pooches.

It's always hard to find a cat groomer with open availability, so I was so happy to find Kay's shop in the area! They are professional, accommodating, skilled, and beyond kind with my kitty Ace. He does get shy for his nail trims, ear cleanings, and sanitary trims, but they do a great job at keeping it quick and easy for him. Thank you for all that you do!
They did a great job and even though she ate one of the bows, they were cute.
Kay is AMAZING and very patient! My pup has some anxiety with nail trimming. Kay is by far the only groomer my dog feels comfortable with! 🫶🏽 …
K is the best we had her as a Groomer at PetSmart until she opened up her own shop. She is super quick and always very pleasant. She is a great groomer.

I tried a few different groomers, looking for the one that will find what cut best suits my good boi. I am so happy we found this place. At the very beginning, Kiara spent 5 min with Hugo and I, making sure she was addressing all my concerns; she analyzed his face features and made recommendations accordingly.
We enjoyed the whole experience - from walking in, to timely updates and finally picking Hugo up looking like a superstar 🤩
(before and after attached)
This is one of the best groomers in the city. I love the place and the people. They treat my pets so well.

Kay's Pooches & Smooches did such a great job on my puppy. I hate the typical electric razor shave. I just wanted her to have shape and to get a few mats out  She looks so cute! They were so caring, warm and professional. Lovely people. Good communication.
Love love loveeeee how handsome, my Biggie boy came out! You can tell he was taken care of with so much love! 10/10 customer service, talent, everything!

Perfect makeover and great experience! Kay made accommodations for my VERY energetic and anxious pup. Because of Kay’s patience, accommodations, knowledge of animal behavior, and exceptional skill; my puppy now has good associations with being groomed. I can’t thank the staff enough for being so thoughtful and thorough for her. It makes a huge difference in the lives of animals ❤️  attached before and after: she’s so smooth now, stopped itching, and smells like coconuts (hard to get pics of her not in motion 😆)
Kay did amazing job with Teddy! Loved the cut and super friendly.
Very good customer service. Super clean,friendly and I highly suggest to anybody in need for their fur babies

I took my 10 year old cat, Gigi, in for a grooming and Kiara did such an amazing job! She updated me throughout the appointment and took such incredible care of Gigi. Will definitely be bringing her back here from now on!
My dogs Marco(RIH) and Bentley have been here Kaileen is the best,  love her personality and Caring for pets..
Couldn’t recommend Kay’s enough!! Kiara is so patient with my baby girl! Prices are also so affordable and the environment there is just so warm and welcoming! Thank you ladies :)
She does amazing work. Oreo was rescued from a fire which is the first picture of what he looked like before Kay did her magic.. Reasonable prices Great customer service for humans and pets..

Couldn't recommend Kay's Pooches enough!!
We drive 35 minutes just to get our Yorkie groomed by Kiara. She does such a great job and makes us and our Zeusy feel so comfortable!

Kiara does an amazing job every single time with Nas. Her and Kay have a warm and safe environment for our pet children to enjoy. Nas always arrives excited and leaves with a smile and  the perfect cut too!
Excellent service, I loved it!!

Kay was wonderful! She really took the time to answer all questions and did everything to ensure my dog was comfortable. We were looking for a breed specific style cut and Kay helped us achieve exactly what we were looking for! She also sent text updates throughout the grooming. Thank you for your excellent care with Margot, Kay!

I brought my persian kitty here during the summer. The technician was very gentle and did a great groom! My cats hair grows excessively. So, I'm booking again with her soon. I'm so happy to find a professional cat groomer near me.
Kay is the best!! She does such a wonderful job with our pup. He always comes home looking as handsome and happy as ever 🐶❤️. …

Kay has done a fantastic job with my mini golden doodle. I’m a new dog parent and she helped walk through what we needed to get the perfect cut and make sure it was a great experience for our pup. My dog loves going and is always happy to be there!

Very happy they could take such good care of my 12 and a half year old Labradoodle, he has osteoarthritis, so a little worried about him standing for too long, Kiara was highly communicative and worked with him and I think he has never received a better haircut!  Thank you!!
Thank you so much for grooming my cat! The service was quick, affordable, and high-quality. My cat, Max, is now clean, brushed, and happy! Highly recommend!

So glad I found Kay’s Pooches & Smooches! I love that the entire process from wash to cut is performed by one groomer as opposed to an assembly line style of operation. My furbaby Oreo looked amazing and I’m very happy with the service we received.

Kay has been incredibly accommodating with our last-minute request for grooming our three pups, and her work is truly amazing. She was exceptionally patient with our 7-year-old Havanese, who is very shy, and managed to groom him in less than two hours—Teddy has never looked better! She also did a fantastic job with our 3-year-old, 40-pound Sheepadoodle, Lord Turtle, who has a long and tangled mane typical of doodles. Kay’s skill and professionalism are top-notch. We are thrilled with her service and will continue to support her shop. Highly recommend!

The best groomer Rupert (Old English Sheepdog) has ever been to! The appointments are quick and he comes out looking amazing! Rupert is never caged and Kayleen takes such great care of him. 10/10 recommend!!!!

Kay is amazing! Our golden retriever absolutely loves her, is super comfortable, and he’s groomed perfectly every time. Very reasonable prices and he’s always done within 2 hours. Love that she only grooms one dog at a time and pays attention to detail. Definitely recommend Kay and her team!

I can't say enough great things about Kays Pooches and Smooches.  From start to finish, the experience was fantastic. The salon is clean, welcoming, and the staff is incredibly professional and friendly. They truly took the time to understand my dog's unique needs and gave them personalized care. My dogs left looking and smelling amazing—so much so that it felt like a mini makeover! The grooming was thorough, gentle, and they even took extra steps to ensure my dogs felt comfortable and relaxed throughout the process. It’s clear that they  have a deep love for animals and takes pride in their work. Highly recommend to anyone looking for top-notch grooming services! We'll definitely be returning.
Kay did a great job with our two small doodles.
Kay and her team are so professional and sweet. Our dogs always come out looking their best and smelling great for a long time. We are frequent customers!

Absolutely fantastic! Kay did an amazing job grooming Messi, and he looked better than ever! 🥰🥰🥰 The attention to detail, gentle care, and professionalism are unmatched ✨ Messi came home happy and stress-free. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a top-notch grooming experience! 🤍🐶 …
